import { BattleFormatGui } from '@src/utils/battleMemoryMessage';
import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 回击
 * 指令：/回击 记录ID
 *
 * 对打劫过自己的人发起反击
 * - 仅消耗元力
 * - 不消耗每日打劫次数
 * - 不增加煞气
 */

import App from '@src/response-apps/counterAttack/app';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  // 提取记录ID
  const idMatch = e.MessageText.match(/(\d+)/);

  if (!idMatch) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('请输入正确指令，示例：/回击 记录ID');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const robberyLogId = Number(idMatch[1]);
  const result = await App({ uid, bid, robberyLogId, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });

  if (result.code === 'INVALID_ID') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(result.data.message);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  if (result.code === 'FAIL') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(result.data.message);
    const footer = result.data.isEnergyInsufficient ? [{ label: '服用元力丹', command: '/服用 元力丹 3' }] : undefined;

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md, footer }));

    return;
  }

  const d = result.data;
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  md.addText(`目标：${d.targetName}`);
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(`胜负：${d.isWin ? '✅ 反击成功' : '❌ 反击失败'}`);
  md.addNewline();
  md.addBlockquote(
    Format.createMarkdown()
      .addText(`战斗类型：${d.sideA.length}v${d.sideB.length},回合数：${d.totalRounds}`)
      .addNewline()
      .addText(`消耗元力：${d.counterHpCost},🔄 反击模式（不消耗次数、不增加煞气）`)
  );

  if (d.isWin) {
    md.addNewline();
    const loot: string[] = [];

    if (d.stoneReward) {
      loot.push(`灵石+${d.stoneReward}`);
    }
    if (d.crystalReward) {
      loot.push(`灵晶+${d.crystalReward}`);
    }
    md.addText(loot.length > 0 ? `💰 ${loot.join(',')}` : '💰 对方身无分文');
    md.addNewline();

    if (d.bonusText) {
      md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(d.bonusText));
    }

    if (d.droppedItem) {
      md.addText(`🎁 掉落：${d.droppedItem.name}×${d.droppedItem.quantity}（${d.droppedItem.category}）`);
      md.addNewline();
    }
  }

  if (d.expReward && d.expReward > 0) {
    md.addText(`📖 获得修为：+${d.expReward}`);
    md.addNewline();
  }

  // 底部按钮
  md.addNewline();

  void message.send(
    await BattleFormatGui(
      {
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '反击',
        content: md,
        footer: [
          { label: '文字记录', command: `/查看战斗过程 ${d.logId}` },
          { label: '打劫记录', command: '/打劫记录' }
        ]
      },
      [{ id: d.logId }]
    )
  );
});
